name: Tsakos Energy Navigation Limited (TEN Ltd)
note: Energy shipping company incorporated in Bermuda, with its office in Athens, Greece, and quoted on the New York Stock Exchange. The 2026 proxy statement's table of holders of 5% or more lists the Liechtenstein Tsakos Holdings Foundation (10.7%, held through First Tsakos Investments and Redmont Trading) and companies controlled by Nikolas and Panayotis Tsakos.
